headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 5, 2026**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies edged out the San Diego Padres 6-4 in a closely contested game, with Zack Wheeler pitching a strong 7.0 innings for the Phillies, striking out 8 and allowing 2 earned runs. Jackson Merrill led the Padres' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, with Jonathan India being transferred to the 60-day injured list for the Kansas City Royals due to a left shoulder subluxation. Trevor Story has also been transferred to the 60-day injured list for the Boston Red Sox with a sports hernia, while Sean Murphy has been moved to the 60-day injured list for the Atlanta Braves with a fractured left middle finger.

The Cincinnati Reds made a trade on June 4, 2026, sending RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash, while the Los Angeles Angels traded C Austin Wynns to the Atlanta Braves for cash. The Minnesota Twins traded RHP Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash, and RHP Justin Lawrence was sent to the Minnesota Twins from the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for cash.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Phillies in Thrilling Matchup**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies edged out the San Diego Padres 6-4 in a closely contested game. Jackson Merrill led the Padres' offense with a home run and two RBIs, while Zack Wheeler pitched a strong 7.0 innings for the Phillies, striking out 8 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 8-2**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured an 8-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Willson Contreras leading the charge at the plate. Contreras hit a home run (12) on a fly ball to left field, contributing to the Orioles' win.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Guardians in Thrilling Match**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Cleveland Guardians 2-1 in a closely contested game. Brent Headrick earned the win for the Yankees, while David Bednar secured the save.

top_news.title: **Giants Take Down Brewers in Thrilling 12-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants outlasted the Milwaukee Brewers in a high-scoring matchup, securing a 12-9 win. Jackson Chourio led the Brewers' offense with a strong performance, going 3-for-4 with 2 home runs and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Update: Jonathan India to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals second baseman Jonathan India has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a left shoulder subluxation. This move comes after initially being placed on the 10-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Reds Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds made a trade on June 4, 2026, sending RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash.
